note: Forbidden: hold expiry with no Hold Timer Expired NOTIFICATION. TestRFC4271HoldTimerExpirySendsNotification reads the production hold-expiry write and asserts 21 octets, type NOTIFICATION, code 4, subcode 0; it is red on a bare close or another code. Negative: at 1ms before expiry nothing is written, red on a NOTIFICATION sent early. deadpeer-holddown.ci is byte-exact.
